card.name: Signs of hyperthyroidism masked by beta-blockers
card.fires_on: The word or piece right before 'tachycardia' (such as 'such as', 'e.g.,', or the 't' of tachycardia) in the beta-blocker warning that signs of hyperthyroidism may be masked.

modes.label: Linking words before tachycardia
modes.description: The words 'as' or 'e.g.,' that introduce tachycardia as an example sign of hyperthyroidism.
modes.example: β-blockers may mask clinical signs of hyperthyroidism, such<< as>> tachycardia. Abrupt

modes.label: Start of tachycardia
modes.description: The first letter 't' of the split word tachycardia in the same warning.
modes.example: Beta-adrenergic blockade may mask clinical signs of hyperthyroidism, such as<< t>>achycardia. Abrupt withdrawal

card.writes: It pushes toward words starting with 'hyper' or 'rest' or 'trem', which are signs of overactivity such as tremor and restlessness.
card.plain: It fires in the beta-blocker warning about hidden hyperthyroid signs, just before tachycardia is named.
